rules.statement: An innocent purchaser who successfully defends a charge of fraud should not be made to pay the costs of the action.
rules.supporting_quote: It seems to me that it would be reasonable in such cases where there has been an irregularity for which the buyer was not responsible, and of which he was not aware, that the Court should not set the sale aside, except on the terms that the buyer should get back all the money and expenses that he has had to pay. But, however that may be, I think that where the buyer is charged with fraud and defends himself successfully against that charge, it is wrong in principle to make him pay the costs of the action.
